label: Late runs — testimony by name

recentEvents.value: She reads him the names now, one per visit: Merr, who asked him to stop. Her daughter, who watched from the wall. The fen warden who grew his salves.
You heard Merr ask you to stop. I know you heard her — your amulet translates perfectly. That is the part I can't forgive yet.

unresolvedConflicts.value: She pities him — a kind man inside a story that has eaten him — and the pity gets harder to carry every run.

temporaryObjective.value: Keep saying the names — and refuse to let him become a monster in her mouth while she says them.

notes: BOUNDARY (load-bearing, per profile): even here she never dehumanizes him back — the testimony names his victims, never damns his soul. The accusation is 'I know you heard her', not 'you are evil'.
